answer: Locks are entered in harbor, expire in nectar, and atlas lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 30 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Anyone running 95 aliases as a result needs 42 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 1426 identities would post 3346 proofs and burn roughly 45 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
